content: Official Flutter publishing documentation includes iOS/App Store Connect and Android/Google Play release steps; Apple Xcode and Android Studio device documentation describe simulator/hardware testing paths. Current Windows environment probe found no Xcode, adb, emulator, Flutter, Java, or Gradle; platform validation requires external hardware/cloud build or installing relevant tooling. Source URLs: docs.flutter.dev/deployment/ios; docs.flutter.dev/deployment/android; developer.apple.com/documentation/xcode/running-your-app-in-simulator-or-on-a-device; developer.android.com/studio/run/device
